verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Hallowed Mist or let her E engage land clean; you win if you blind every E dash and out-range her before Needlework ranks up.

brief.thesis: Gwen's real damage comes entirely from autos and her E-empowered on-hit, which means she has to physically walk into your 680-range Q and poison poke to do anything at all. Blind her the instant she commits E (Skip 'n Slash) and the whole engage whiffs — no on-hit magic damage, no passive heal, no cooldown refund. Her counter is W (Hallowed Mist): she can sit in it and simply can't be targeted unless you walk in, so she controls when trades restart. Over 522 recorded games this is dead even at 50%, so play it like a skill matchup, not a loss.

theirWindow.what: She'll dash in for empowered attack speed, range, and on-hit magic damage. Land Q (Blinding Dart) the moment she arrives — blinded autos deal nothing, deny her passive heal, and don't refund her E's cooldown.

yourWindow.what: She has no gap closer for 13 to 11 seconds depending on rank. Auto-poke freely with E (Toxic Shot) and chip Q in whenever it's up, since your range outreaches her 450-range Q cone and 400-range E dash.

start.item: Doran's Ring > Health Potion > Health Potion
start.why: sustains you through the poison poke war and keeps mana up for Q spam, run on 74.8% of games at 49.5% win rate.

boots.why: magic pen scales both Q blind damage and Toxic Shot's DoT, and outperforms Swiftness in this matchup (52.6% vs 46.7%).

core.why: energized autos and attack speed keep Toxic Shot ticking and give you movement speed to hold range against her E dash.
the burn stacks off your poison and Shiv procs, shredding max health damage through Hallowed Mist's defensive window.
cooldown reduction tightens your Q cycle so blind uptime stays high against her repeated engage attempts.

runes.keystoneWhy: rewards the consistent on-hit poke you're already running with Toxic Shot and punishes any trade Gwen is forced into.

summoners.why: the dominant page at 92.8% pick and 49.4% win rate; Ignite's grievous wounds cuts the healing she gets off A Thousand Cuts during an all-in, and Flash lets you reset after baiting from Camouflage.

playing.title: Blind the E engage
playing.detail: The instant Gwen dashes with E to start a trade, fire Q so her empowered autos whiff. This denies the on-hit damage, the passive heal, and the cooldown refund all at once, locking her E on its full timer.

playing.title: Poke outside her range
playing.detail: Toxic Shot applies on every auto at no cooldown cost. Since her Q cone is 450 range and her E dash is 400, hold the poke war whenever both your abilities are up and hers aren't.

playing.title: Never walk into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: When she pops W, back off instead of chasing. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist, so walking in is the only way you hand her a trade she otherwise can't force.

playing.title: Ambush from Camouflage
playing.detail: Stand still in river or tri-brush to go invisible, then open with Q blind and ride the Element of Surprise attack speed boost through the follow-up autos.

playing.title: Seed Noxious Traps at chokepoints
playing.detail: R is nearly free to recast. Drop mushrooms in jungle entrances and river crossings so the slow and damage punish her E dash-ins and tip off ganks.

playing.title: Race her Needlework rank
playing.detail: Her R starts at a 120 second cooldown and only becomes a real threat once ranked toward its fastest cooldown. Through roughly level 15 it's not live enough to respect — don't play scared of a poke that isn't there yet.

playing.title: Save Ignite for her all-in
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts heals her off on-hit damage. Hold Ignite until she commits Q and E together rather than burning it on a single poke, so the grievous wounds actually matters.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, summoner spells, and every win-rate and sample-size number above are pulled from measured games on the current patch. The read on cooldown timings and ability interactions is my own tactical analysis, not part of that data.
